memories.title: Death saves as a Condition
memories.context: Death saves need to react to multiple events (turn start, damage, healing). Could be special-cased or fit existing pattern.
memories.reasoning: Conditions already subscribe to bus events and react passively. Death saves are exactly this: react to turn start (roll), damage (auto-fail), healing (wake up).
consequences: Testing uses same patterns as other conditions

memories.title: Unresolved death save design questions
memories.description: Several gameplay decisions not yet made: manual vs auto roll, post-death behavior, Medicine checks, monster targeting.
memories.impact: Won't block initial implementation but need answers before polish.
memories.workaround: Start with auto-roll, remove from encounter on death. Revisit later.
